$meta.title: Paper III — dynamics + observational-resolution taxonomy
$meta.purpose: Zoom-out index of the Paper-III dynamics / observational-resolution collection. Load first for the shape; follow `detail` pointers to drill in.
$meta.what_is_it: Finite-sample dynamical reconstruction + an observational-resolution-dimension programme: finite-sample rates n^(-s/(2s+D)) read as driven by observable distinguishability growth (D a resolution exponent, not topological dimension), plus the fibre-mixing/collision bridge connecting geometric refinement to σ-algebra generation.
$meta.status: MIXED. Three sub-programmes: (1) observational-resolution-dimension = LIVE future target (coherent, dormant from Papers I-III); (2) fibre-mixing bridge = DEAD with a located disintegration error (2026-05-14); (3) operational-boundary = BIFURCATED (chain-detection killed by Kolmogorov extension, smoothness-concentration detection survives). Lyapunov + interaction = deferred separate directions.
$meta.the_shape: The live core is 'rate exponent D = growth/scale' across many valuations (Cantor, smooth, hyperbolic, logic, spectral) — a unifying remark with 10 guardrails. The dead fibre-mixing thread located one precise error (p_z vs p_z^2 disintegration weighting) that falsifies the bridge theorem both directions but yields a corrected conditional version + a clean geometric-vs-algebraic distinction. Operational-boundary kept one live result (smoothness-concentration: PFA charges can't be uniformly Hölder-smooth).

observational_resolution.name: Valued-refinement rate theorem
observational_resolution.one_line: Classical n^(-s/(2s+D)) made rigorous in the valued-refinement framework; needs the 3 assumptions proved in ≥2 examples before integration.

observational_resolution.name: Resolution exponent ≠ topology
observational_resolution.one_line: Cantor gives D=log2/log3 (topological dim 0); smooth manifolds give D=d. The rate exponent is a scaling exponent, not topology.

observational_resolution.name: Collision-entropy specialization
observational_resolution.one_line: For balanced finite algebras, collision entropy H_2 agrees with atom-count entropy; dimensions asymptotically equivalent when atoms are comparable in mass.

observational_resolution.name: Observational pseudometric / info-geometry
observational_resolution.one_line: d_obs(x,y)=sqrt(D_sym(P_x,P_y)) recovers the Fisher metric locally and a scaling dimension in fractal settings.

observational_resolution.name: Young's formula as special case
observational_resolution.one_line: HD(μ)=h_μ(f)(1/λ1+1/|λ2|) is the measure-relative branch of D_Λ once Papers I/II supply the data.

guardrails.name: Exact collisions vanish (continuous injective)
guardrails.one_line: For continuous injective Φ and atomless μ, exact collision probability is 0 — not a dimension; must use finite algebras / ε-coarse collision / covering numbers.

guardrails.name: Refinement alone ≠ dimension
guardrails.one_line: A refinement sequence needs a valuation Λ(k) (scale/cost/description-length); without Λ, no dimension.

guardrails.name: Multifractal / local-global disagreement
guardrails.one_line: Local, Hausdorff, box, Rényi-q, effective dimensions can differ; no single global D without uniformity (Coates–Gelfert 2025).

guardrails.name: Valuation may not be intrinsic
guardrails.one_line: Deepest risk: Λ externally chosen, not forced. Cantor/smooth/hyperbolic supply it canonically; zeta/logical do not ⟹ theorem conditional on chosen valuation.

guardrails.name: Observable dimension = quotient dimension
guardrails.one_line: Observation collapses states; the relevant dimension is the observable factor X/~, not the hidden space, unless faithfulness is proved.

guardrails.name: Paper III scope creep
guardrails.one_line: Paper III spine is fixed; the observational-dimension programme is at most a restrained remark about D as resolution exponent, not a replacement.

fibre_mixing.name: Bridge theorem (DEAD — located error)
fibre_mixing.one_line: Claimed E[Var(1_S|O_L)]=(1/2)∫|1_S−1_S'|²d(μ⊗μ). FALSE: LHS=Σ p_z·μ_z(S)μ_z(Sᶜ) but RHS=Σ p_z²·(...) — disintegration of (μ⊗μ)|R_L weights by p_z² not p_z, since (μ|F_z)^⊗2 = p_z²(μ_z⊗μ_z). Both directions false.

fibre_mixing.name: Entropy characterization (DEAD)
fibre_mixing.one_line: δ(L)→0 ⟺ H_2(ν_L)→∞ depended on the bridge theorem. Skew-product counterexample (X=A^Z×B^Z, T=σ×σ, h=a_0, S={b_0=0}): δ_L=1/4 ∀L yet collision→0. Equivalence is one-way only.

fibre_mixing.name: Geometric vs algebraic reconstruction
fibre_mixing.one_line: Two independent quantities: collision Σ p_z² (geometric fibre refinement) vs algebraic defect δ_L(S)=Σ p_z μ_z(S)μ_z(Sᶜ) (σ-algebra generation). Small fibres do NOT guarantee complete algebraic resolution. The durable yield of the dead thread.

fibre_mixing.name: Corrected bridge theorem (conditional)
fibre_mixing.one_line: TRUE version: if large-fibre contribution κ:=∫_{p_z≥ε} p_z·min(α_z,1−α_z)dν ≥ η>0 then ν(G(η))≥2(κ−η). Uses a pointwise UPPER bound (1/2), no ergodicity. The honest replacement.

fibre_mixing.name: Fibre-mixing irreducibility (PARKED)
fibre_mixing.one_line: Is fibre mixing derivable from a structural condition, or irreducible like CE? Steps 1–5 (continuous logic, LBL vs UFM, irrational-rotation witnesses) show the framing is right but the irreducibility proof/failure-witness stays elusive.

fibre_mixing.name: Bridge Steps A (κ-bound) + B (a.e. balance)
fibre_mixing.one_line: Step A: explicit lower bound on the large-fibre contribution κ (analytic, no dynamics). Step B: does ergodicity force a.e. large-fibre balance for near-maximizers? Asserted, proof absent.

operational_boundary.name: Operational boundary theorem (PFA detection)
operational_boundary.one_line: Detect purely-finitely-additive contamination ε via min-contamination estimator trajectory ε̂(n). Chain-detection route KILLED by Kolmogorov extension (PFA vs σ-additive marginals indistinguishable at fixed resolution).

operational_boundary.name: Multi-resolution chain detection (DEAD)
operational_boundary.one_line: PFA charge as nested ultrafilter chain across levels, K~log(1/ε) levels. FAILED: adversary spreads contamination over many chains; any projective marginal family is σ-additive-indistinguishable at finite resolution.

operational_boundary.name: Smoothness-concentration bound (LIVE)
operational_boundary.one_line: On a compact Stone space, if a PFA charge's marginals are all Hölder-smooth w.r.t. λ, the charge must be σ-additive (non-σ-add ⟹ E_j↓∅ with mass≥c but λ(E_j)→0, contradiction). The surviving novel tool.

operational_boundary.name: ε̂(n) trajectory as consistent PFA test
operational_boundary.one_line: ε̂(n)→ε_0 a.s.; rate test T_n=ε̂(n)·n^(s/(2s+D)) is O_P(1) under σ-additive H_0, →∞ under PFA H_1. Threshold n≳exp((2s+D)k_0).

directions.name: Observable separation exponent (Lyapunov, Option 1)
directions.one_line: λ_h(x,y)=limsup (1/n)log d(Φ_h(T^n x),Φ_h(T^n y)); observable separation growth, should recover top Lyapunov under smoothness + faithful reconstruction. Best near-term target.

directions.name: Conditional-law divergence exponent (Option 2)
directions.one_line: λ_obs=limsup (1/t)log D(Π_t(q,·),Π_t(q',·)); growth rate of observational-law distinguishability. KL choice connects to entropy production / Pesin.

directions.name: Interaction-class discrimination (separate programme)
directions.one_line: Distinguish mutualism/competition/parasitism/commensalism/neutrality via joint query systems + predictive-effect signatures. Standalone ~10–15pp; not part of the core arc.
